notes.title: 2.4.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Guardians and Bosses!

In this update, we’re introducing a new feature: the Quick Cast option!  
If you're already familiar with boss skill ranges, Quick Cast allows you to instantly cast a skill in the position of your mouse with a single key press.  
We've also completely reworked Grizzly's [Frenzy] ability, which previously had very low popularity.

We’re currently focusing development efforts on the highly requested Guardian AI.  
Progress is going well, and we’re hoping to introduce it in the next update.

🌟 New Features & Improvements  
  
 Boss Quick Cast: Added an option for instantly casting skills in the direction of the mouse upon pressing a shortcut key.
  

---

notes.notes:
Hello, Guardians and Bosses!  

This update brings even more new content as previously announced.  
A new Guardian, Vespa, and a new Boss, Walric, are joining the battlefield!  

Vespa is a fast-paced melee damage dealer who can develop into one of three playstyles: ranged spear throws, close-range spear throws, or enhanced basic attacks.  
Walric is a relatively easy-to-play boss who creates chaotic battles with his large-area abilities and vision-blocking skills.  

Enjoy even more diverse battles with these new characters!

notes.title: 2.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Guardians and Bosses!

In this update, we've revamped various elements, including the experience system, to provide a more refined gameplay experience.  
Guardians can now enjoy the process of building their desired playstyle through leveling up, while Bosses have been enhanced to unleash increasingly threatening attacks as the phases progress.  
Additionally, several user convenience features requested through feedback have been implemented.

Many players have been anticipating new Bosses and characters. A related update is scheduled for March.  
Consider this update as a foundational improvement to ensure higher quality before adding new content.

---  
🌟 New Features & Improvements  
  
 Added nickname change feature.  
- Available in the bottom right of the main menu, changeable every 14 days.  
 Added custom keybinding feature.  
 Added nickname filtering feature.  
 Ability level stats are now displayed in advance.  

 Experience System Revamp:  
- All experience gain has been increased by 1.5x.  
- The maximum level has been expanded from 6 to 7.  
- At the start of the game, you can now choose 2 Abilities immediately.  
- You cannot upgrade Abilities until all 6 Ability slots are filled.  
- The performance of all level 1 Abilities has been reduced.  

 All Boss skill damage now increases by 10% in Phase 2 and 30% in Phase 3.  
 All Guardian health has been increased 10x, with related stats adjusted accordingly.  
 Tutorial text has been simplified.  
  
---  

⚖ Balance Adjustments  
  
Guardians  
  
Mink (Rogue)  
  
 Movement Speed: 110% -> 105%  
 Base Attack Damage: 30 -> 32  
 Base Poison Damage: 5% -> 3%  
  
Crow (Shieldbearer)  
  
 Skill Cooldown: 12 -> 13  
  
Fenna (Healer)  
  
 Max HP: 800 -> 700  
 Skill Healing Amount: 15 -> 12  
  
  

Adjustments were made to classes that benefit significantly from the new system and those with excessively high or low win rates.  

Map Gimmicks  
  
 Shield gimmick protection: 15 -> 10% of max HP  
  

Perks  

With the introduction of the new experience system, all level 1 Abilities have been reduced to 60–80% of their previous effectiveness.  
Below are additional adjustments made to certain Abilities, while some have retained their original values.  

  
 Damage Increase: 0.2/0.45/0.75 -> 0.15/0.40/0.75  
 Movement Speed Increase: 0.08/0.2/0.35 (Unchanged)  
 Stamina Recovery Speed: 0.2/0.45/0.75 -> 0.15/0.35/0.7  
 Roll Cost: 35/28/20 -> 35/27/18  
 Shield: 5/12/20 -> 3/10/20  
 Max HP Increase: 0.1/0.25/0.5 -> 0.1/0.3/0.6  
 Roll Defense: 5/12/20 -> 5/12/25  
 Damage Reflection: 0.1/0.225/0.4 -> 0.1/0.25/0.5  
  

Class Exclusive Abilities  

  
 Raven  
  
 Agility  
 0.55/0.75/1 -> 0.55/0.8/1.2  
 Deadeye  
 0.35/0.75/1.25 -> 0.25/0.6/1.0  
  
  
  
 Mink

 1/2/3 (Unchanged)  
 Stealth  
 1/2.5/4 (Unchanged)  
 Poison  
 Base: 0.05, 0.15/0.3/0.5 -> Base: 0.03, 0.1/0.2/0.35  
  
  
  
 Mander  
  
 Wisdom  
 10/25/45 (Unchanged)  
  
  
  
 Fenna  
  
 Flash  
 0.1/0.25/0.45 (Unchanged)  
  
  
---  

Bosses  
  
With the new system significantly strengthening Guardians, Bosses have been enhanced accordingly.  

Skill damage now increases as phases progress:  
Phase 1: +0%  
Phase 2: +10%  
Phase 3: +30%  
Phase HP distribution has been adjusted:  
Previous: 100% > 60% > 30%  
New: 100% > 70% > 35%  

  
Dovinic  
  
 Max HP: 11000 -> 11500  
  

Tortan  
  
 Max HP: 14500 -> 15500  
 Skill 1: Damage: 9 -> 11  
 Skill 2:  
 - Damage: 12 -> 14  
 - Cast Time: 2s -> 1.8s  
 Skill 3: Cooldown: 10 -> 8  
 Skill 4: Cooldown: 30 -> 25  
 Skill 5: Improved projectile accuracy  
  

Mouster  
  
 Max HP: 14500 -> 15000  
 Skill 1: Duration: 20 -> 25  
 Skill 2: Area: 0.9 -> 1.4  
 Skill 3: Cooldown: 18 -> 15  
 Skill 5: Cooldown: 30 -> 25  
  

Perks

 Meteor: Meteor drop interval: 5.5s -> 6s  

  
  
---  

🛠 Bug Fixes  
  
 Fixed an issue where the initial enemy spawn timer was not displayed correctly.  
 Fixed a bug where certain Boss skills weren't affected by Consume perk.  
 Fixed an issue where the kick function was not working properly.  
 Fixed a bug where player ghost images remained in the lobby when joining a game with a host change in progress.  
 Fixed an issue where Bosses could move while using skills when controlled via gamepad.  
 Various minor bug fixes.

Feedback is always welcome!

notes.title: 2.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Guardians and Bosses!

In this update, we have revamped the playstyles of Toltan and Mouster, along with major balance adjustments. Additionally, we have fixed several previously undiscovered bugs and introduced a few quality-of-life improvements.

--- 
🌟 New Features & Improvements
  
 Death count is now displayed below the left character HUD.
- Guardians’ respawn time increases by 1.5 seconds each time they fall; Having a death counter will help Guardians make a better decision on when to try a revival or not.
 Start screen interaction changed from "Hold to Start" → "Press Any Button to Start."
 Added a lobby entry notification sound.
- Now, even if you're doing something else after creating a public match, you can hear the footsteps of Guardians joining through the forest.

---  

⚖ Balance Adjustments 
  
Guardians

Mink (Rogue)  
Skill Energy Cost: 20 → 25  
Mink, when played by a skilled player, excels in mobility, damage output, and mob clearing due to the nature of its movement speed and skill mechanics. Therefore, we slightly increased the skill energy cost to reduce its overall stability.
Grizzly (Axeman)  
Skill Energy Cost: 30 → 20  
Grizzly, as a melee character, must take risks to deal damage due to its skill activation time. While the character may seem simple, it actually requires a high level of skill to play effectively. Since this risk resulted in an excessively low survival rate, we have reduced its skill energy cost.

Perk/Ability

 Berserk - Damage increase proportional to lost HP: 30%/70%/120% → 40%/90%/150%  
Previously, the return was too low compared to the risk. Now, maintaining low HP will provide a more substantial benefit compared to the standard damage increase Ability.
 Shield - Shield granted after 10 seconds without taking damage: 7/15/25 → 5/12/20  
This perk provided excessive stability compared to others, making it almost mandatory for ranged Guardians. We have adjusted it accordingly.
 Recovery - HP regeneration per second: 3/2/1 → 5/3/1  
In the 300-second (5-minute) raid, this perk could theoretically provide up to 100 HP even at level 1. Now, investing level-up points is required to maintain the same performance as before.


Bosses

Dovinic  
  
Skill 5 cooldown: 10s → 9s.  

Toltan  
  
Skill 1 Rework: Now sends out 2 shockwaves—one within the inner area and one in the outer area. During the latter part of the skill, movement and other skill usage are allowed.  
Cooldown: 3 → 10  
Damage: 15 → 8  
Cast Time: 1.4 → 4.5 (1.5s startup → 1.5s inner hit → 1.5s outer hit)  
Range: 10 → 23
Skill 2 Damage: 15 → 12  
Skill 4 Cast Time: 1.5s → 1s  
Skill 5 & 6: Activation animation time: 2s → 1s, Skill duration: 20s → 16s  
  
Toltan had excellent close-range zoning due to Skill 1. However, it was ineffective against ranged Guardians who were familiar with its range. Now, it allows Toltan to pressure the ranged Guardian classes and enhance its unique playstyle of setting up skills and then using Skill 2 and Skill 3 for closing in.
Additionally, we have shortened the long animation times of Skills 4, 5, and 6 to make the gameplay feel smoother.

Mouster  
  
Skill 1 Range: 4 → 3  
Skill 4  
Now allows other actions while in use.  
Cooldown: 20 → 25  
Damage: 10 → 8  
Range: 15 → 13.5  
Skill 6  
Summoned minions: 8 → 5  
  
Mouster’s Skill 4 was a situational and somewhat underwhelming ability. Previously, it felt like a skill that could only be effective after greatly increasing the number of summoned minions with its ultimate.  
While it is true that bosses should be strongest in their final phase, Mouster had an extreme late-game reliance. By making Skill 4 more useful on its own and slightly nerfing other abilities, we have aimed for a more balanced and versatile playstyle.

Perks

 Death Mark: 1.75x damage amplification for 5 seconds → 1.8x  
 Protection Totem: Base HP 600 with 1.5x scaling → 450 HP with 2x scaling  
 Meteor: Meteor fall interval: 13s → 10s  
We have adjusted perks that had excessively high or low win rates. In particular, Guardian Totem was providing at least 1800 HP, making it very impactful. While the total healing remains the same if left untouched, active Guardian engagement in destroying the totem will now make raid progression smoother.
  
  

🛠 Bug Fixes  
  
 Fixed multiple incorrect descriptions.  
 Fixed a bug where pressing the [Set AI] button immediately at the start of the gameplay tutorial would cause progression to be blocked.  
 Fixed a bug where double-clicking during Raven’s skill activation would automatically charge the skill.  
 Fixed a bug where Consume perk from Phase 1 Perks did not apply to persistent damage (purple attacks).  
 Fixed an issue where normal attacks would trigger while selecting Perks with the mouse.  
 Fixed a bug where forcibly closing a Guardian’s game would leave an unremovable ghost in the lobby.  
 Fixed a bug where the selected character appearance would change after role swaps or player exits.  
 Fixed an issue where the healer’s basic attack was blocked by fallen Guardians.  
  
---  

We always welcome feedback!  
Find teammates and ask questions on our 5-Minute Raid Discord server!  
Enjoy the raid! 🔥  

Discord Server Link:  
https://discord.gg/MgnGHPtz4F

notes.title: 2.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!  
This update brings balance adjustments and an overhaul of the mob system to enhance the overall gameplay experience. Instead of the frustrating experience of mobs disappearing due to time limits, we've reworked the system to reward quick mob clears while still maintaining meaningful strategic experience for the boss players.

Now, mobs no longer have a time limit. Instead of spawning periodically every 30 seconds, a new wave of mobs will appear only if all current mobs are defeated!

---

🌟 New Features and Improvements  
  
Added left and right navigation buttons for cycling through tips.  
Mob System Overhaul  
  
The time limit for mobs has been removed. A new wave of mobs spawns 15 seconds after all current mobs are defeated.  
Passive experience gain has been reduced from 10 per 10 seconds → 5 per 10 seconds.  
   
---

⚖ Balance Adjustments  
  
Guardians  
  
Mink (Assassin)  
  
Basic attack damage: 35 → 30.  
Skill Energy cost: 15 → 20.  
  

Grizzly (Axeman)  
  
Attack recovery time: 1.1 seconds → 0.9 seconds.  
Skill activation time: 1.5 seconds → 1.25 seconds.  
  

Raven (Ranger)  
  
Skill charge time: 2 seconds → 1.5 seconds.  
The notification sound for a fully charged shot is now louder.  
  
  

Bosses  
  
Dovinic  
  
Skill 4 damage: 9 → 8.  
Skill 4 activation time: 1.5 seconds → 1.7 seconds.  
Skill 5 cooldown: 8 seconds → 9 seconds.  
  

Mouster  
  
Skill 1 duration: 15 seconds → 20 seconds.  
Skill 2 area increased: 0.8 → 0.9.  
Skill 3 thickness doubled, slight cooldown reduction, damage increased: 6 → 7.  
Skill 4 area increased: 12 → 15, damage increased: 9 → 10.  
Maximum health increased by 1000.  
  

Toltan

Boss maximum health when there are 2 Guardians: 65% → 60%.  
   
---

Your feedback is always welcome! Whether through comments or the Steam community, we appreciate your input.  
Enjoy the raid!

Guardians

Mink  
  
Basic attacks now apply 5% Vulnerability Poison.

Mander

Raven

Thank you for playing! Hope you have a fun raid.
